proposal.hypothesis: The selected parent creates a region per timestep at a one-thread budget but keeps one persistent team for larger budgets. This candidate changes only the multi-thread region lifetime: it uses a region per timestep for every positive parallel budget while retaining the same row partition, stencil arithmetic, and serial cutoff. At one thread its behavior remains comparable to the parent; at four threads the comparison tests whether six team creations cost more than the persistent region and its inter-step barriers. No speedup is assumed before controller measurement.

retained: Retained the original serial stencil, initialization, six-step ping-pong parity, and small-work serial cutoff.
Retained balanced contiguous row-block ownership based on the actual OpenMP team size and the call's threads budget.
Changed parallel dispatch so every positive parallel budget creates a separate OpenMP region for each timestep, enabling comparison against the parent's persistent multi-thread region.
